What the API 570 Piping Inspector examination tests

The examination is built around API 570, ASME B31.3, ASME Section V, ASME Section IX, API 574, API 577 and API 578. Preparation concentrates on piping classes and inspection intervals, CML placement and spacing, injection points and dead legs, and minimum thickness calculation — and, for the open-book portion, on locating the governing clause quickly, which is as much a practised skill as a knowledge one.

How the preparation is structured

  • Code familiarisation and tabbing, so the reference set is navigable under time pressure rather than merely owned
  • Calculation drilling until the routine problems are automatic — this is consistently the strongest predictor of passing
  • Content-area teaching against the current body of knowledge, including any changes from the previous edition
  • Timed full-length practice examinations, followed by targeted remediation of the weak areas they expose
  • Guidance on eligibility documentation and employer attestation, which delays more candidates than the examination itself does

Delivery in Atlanta

Programmes run as public cohorts, as on-site corporate cohorts at your own facility where several candidates are preparing together, and as blended delivery with theory completed online and the intensive block in person. On-site delivery is usually the better economics above about six candidates, and it lets the worked examples use your own equipment and asset types.

The Atlanta asset base

Atlanta anchors a deep Southeast US industrial base, with Georgia-Pacific paper-and-chemical mills, Delta TechOps' Hartsfield-Jackson aerospace MRO facility, and Southern Company's nuclear fleet (Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4) all running rigorous pressure-equipment and weld-integrity programmes within a few hours' drive. Colonial Pipeline's headquarters and its 5,500-mile fuels backbone — terminating refined product across the Eastern Seaboard — coordinates inspection planning from Alpharetta, making digital twin pipeline integrity data a board-level concern after the 2021 cyber incident exposed continuity risk. Hot, humid summers and frequent thunderstorms accelerate external CUI on tank-farm clusters in nearby Doraville and at the Port of Savannah supply chain, where colour-coded 3D condition mapping reduces unnecessary blasting and repaint scope.

After certification

Certification is the beginning of the responsibility rather than the end of the study. Inspectors holding this credential are generally expected to own an inspection programme — interval setting, CML register quality, evidence retention and audit defence — which are programme skills rather than examination skills.
